mapper.select: SELECT j.* FROM paper_processing_job j WHERE j.status = 'pending' AND j.is_delete = 0 AND j.next_retry_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM paper p WHERE p.id = j.paper_id AND p.is_delete = 0) ORDER BY j.next_retry_time, j.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE paper_processing_job SET status = 'running', lease_token = #{token}, lease_until = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{leaseSeconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), start_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), end_time = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending' AND is_delete = 0 AND next_retry_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM paper_processing_job WHERE status = 'running' AND is_delete = 0 AND lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY lease_until, id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

UPDATE paper_processing_job SET status = IF(retry_count < max_retries, 'pending', 'failed'), end_time = IF(retry_count < max_retries, NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), next_retry_time = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{delaySeconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorCode}, lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), retry_count = IF(retry_count < max_retries, retry_count + 1, retry_count) WHERE id = #{id} AND lease_token = #{token} AND status = 'running' AND is_delete = 0
AND lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)

UPDATE paper_processing_job j SET lease_until = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{leaseSeconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{job.id} AND lease_token = #{job.leaseToken} AND status = 'running' AND is_delete = 0 AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{maxSeconds}, start_time) > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM paper p WHERE p.id = j.paper_id AND p.is_delete = 0)

UPDATE paper_processing_job j JOIN paper p ON p.id = j.paper_id SET j.current_step = #{step}, j.total_chunks = #{total}, j.indexed_chunks = #{indexed}, j.update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), p.status = IF(p.active_index_version IS NULL, 'processing', p.status), p.update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE j.id = #{job.id} AND j.lease_token = #{job.leaseToken} AND j.status = 'running' AND j.is_delete = 0 AND p.is_delete = 0 AND j.lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)

UPDATE paper p JOIN paper_processing_job j ON p.id = j.paper_id SET p.title = IF(#{parsed.title} = '', p.title, LEFT(#{parsed.title}, 500)), p.authors = IF(#{parsed.authors} = '' OR NOT #{parsed.authorsTrusted}, p.authors, LEFT(#{parsed.authors}, 1000)), p.abstract_text = IF(#{parsed.abstractText} = '', p.abstract_text, #{parsed.abstractText}), p.page_count = COALESCE(#{parsed.pageCount}, p.page_count), p.update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), j.current_step = 'chunking', j.update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE j.id = #{job.id} AND j.lease_token = #{job.leaseToken} AND j.status = 'running' AND j.is_delete = 0 AND p.is_delete = 0 AND j.lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND (p.active_index_version IS NULL OR p.active_index_version <= j.index_version)

UPDATE paper_processing_job j JOIN paper p ON p.id = j.paper_id SET j.status = 'completed', j.current_step = 'done', j.total_chunks = #{total}, j.indexed_chunks = #{total}, j.end_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), j.update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), j.lease_token = NULL, j.lease_until = NULL, j.error_code = NULL, j.error_message = NULL, p.status = 'ready', p.active_index_version = j.index_version, p.active_index_attempt = #{job.leaseToken}, p.update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE j.id = #{job.id} AND j.lease_token = #{job.leaseToken} AND j.status = 'running' AND j.is_delete = 0 AND p.is_delete = 0 AND j.lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{maxSeconds}, j.start_time) > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND (p.active_index_version IS NULL OR p.active_index_version <= j.index_version)

UPDATE paper p JOIN paper_processing_job j ON p.id = j.paper_id SET p.status = 'failed', p.update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE j.id = #{id} AND j.status = 'failed' AND j.is_delete = 0 AND p.is_delete = 0 AND p.active_index_version IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM paper_processing_job newer WHERE newer.paper_id = p.id AND newer.is_delete = 0 AND newer.index_version > j.index_version)
